search_notes: GAIN (AIO/CALGP/ACO; Krankenhaus Nordwest, Goetze). ASCO 2025 abstract 4008, 'Final results from the phase III AIO/CALGP/ACO-GAIN-Trial', names NCT03673072; read in full through the Crossref record of the abstract DOI because ascopubs.org refuses scripted fetches. Neoadjuvant/perioperative gemcitabine + cisplatin vs upfront surgery: median OS 27.8 vs 14.6 months, HR 0.46 (0.22-0.96), p=0.04; R0 resection 62.5% vs 33.3%. TREAT WITH CARE: recruitment was stopped for slow enrolment after 68 patients (registry planned 300); the analysis covers 62 (32 vs 30) at a median follow-up of 11.8 months, and the abstract states no prespecified significance boundary; coded met on the reported p value. Date is the supplement's online date (Crossref DOI deposit and OpenAlex publication date, 2025-05-28); ASCO may have put the abstract online a few days earlier, not confirmed; meeting 30 May-3 June 2025 (Deutsches Aerzteblatt report of July 2025, opened, cites the same abstract and mentions no earlier presentation). No journal paper yet (Europe PMC by NCT, title and author); registry completed, no results posted; EU register (2017-004444-38): DE completed, AT prematurely ended, no results. No earlier AIO or sponsor announcement found in one web search.

Zhejiang Cancer Hospital (Cheng Xiangdong; CSPC collaborator), nab-paclitaxel + S-1 vs XELOX/CAPOX, primary endpoint 3-year DFS rate. Primary analysis not disclosed. TREAT WITH CARE: three interim descriptive abstracts exist, each naming NCT04135781 and read in full through Crossref: ASCO 2022 abstract 4052 (146 patients, 1-year DFS 95.5% vs 72.8%), ASCO GI 2023 abstract 386 (233 patients, 89.0% vs 76.9%) and ASCO 2023 abstract 4054 (313 of the planned 616 randomised by Jan 2023, median follow-up 5.16 months, 1-year DFS 87.1% vs 70.2%; 'the median DFS and 3-year DFS rates were not reached'). None gives a hypothesis test or hazard ratio; they report a 'trend' while enrolment was still under way, so they are not the primary analysis. Nothing later found: Crossref title scans (nab-paclitaxel or albumin-bound paclitaxel + gastric, 2021-2026, covering ASCO, ASCO GI and ESMO supplements; by investigator), Europe PMC by NCT (3 records, none with results), PubMed and Europe PMC by title and investigator, one Chinese-language web search. With half the patients enrolled by early 2023 a 3-year DFS analysis is unlikely before 2027. Registry status unknown, not updated since Mar 2020, no results. NORDICA (phase 2, diffuse type, ASCO 2026 abstract 4085) is a different trial.

NeoFOL-R (Seoul National University Hospital). Not read out. The protocol paper (BMC Cancer, 2026-02-24, PMID 41735896, abstract read) says the study is ongoing, started Feb 2024 in South Korea, Australia and Taiwan, with a 5-year enrolment period, at least 2 years of follow-up and 171 deaths needed; the registry date of 2024-12 cannot be the primary analysis. Registry: recruiting, last updated Nov 2024, no results. Europe PMC by NCT (9 records, protocol and reviews only), PubMed and Crossref title scan by acronym and by FOLFIRINOX + resectable: no result. Reported sibling trials are not this one (NORPACT-1, PREOPANC-2, PREOPANC-3 protocol, NEPAFOX).

Fudan University, radiotherapy alone vs concurrent chemoradiotherapy in nasopharyngeal carcinoma with undetectable EBV DNA after one induction cycle; non-inferiority design (flag for the exclusion review). No result found. Registry: recruiting, 366 planned, start Jan 2022, 2-year PFS endpoint, registered Jan 2023 and never updated since, no results, no investigator named; with enrolment still open in 2023 a 2-year PFS analysis is not expected before 2026-2027. Europe PMC by NCT: one 2024 review only. PubMed (nasopharyngeal + EBV DNA + radiotherapy alone + randomised, 2024-2026): 0. Crossref title scan (nasopharyngeal + EBV + alone/omit/de-escalation, 2022-2026): only a retrospective Fudan cohort of the same question (Kong et al., Cancers 2023; ASCO 2023 abstract 6064; ASTRO 2023), titles seen, not this trial. One Chinese-language web search: registry mirrors and the same retrospective study.

Sun Yat-sen University (Ye Wei-jun), adjuvant paclitaxel + cisplatin vs observation after chemoradiation in node-positive cervical cancer, primary 3-year PFS. No result found. Registry: status unknown, 432 planned, never updated since Mar 2018, no results. Europe PMC by NCT: 3 records (reviews and an unrelated ctDNA paper). PubMed by design terms (cervical + adjuvant/consolidation chemotherapy + chemoradiation + randomised + node, 2021-2026) returns other trials only (OUTBACK, ACTLACC, JGOG1082, STARS-type postoperative trials); PubMed and Crossref by investigator: nothing on this trial. Crossref title scan (cervical + adjuvant + chemoradiation, 2019-2026, covering ASCO, ESMO and ASTRO supplements): nothing. One Chinese-language web search: registry mirrors only. Medium because the estimated completion date (Mar 2025) is well past, the record is eight years stale and Chinese domestic meetings and journals (CSCO, CSTRO, CNKI) cannot be searched from here; the trial may also never have completed accrual.

Wake Forest (Farris), SBRT + pembrolizumab vs pembrolizumab, stage IV NSCLC. Ended with 5 patients enrolled (4 vs 1); no primary analysis is possible. The registry shows completed, not terminated, and gives no reason for stopping, but results were posted on 2025-06-13 (API record read): counts only (1 of 4 vs 0 of 1 with a progression event) and the statement 'Due to these small numbers statistical analysis (e.g., rates, statistical comparisons of arms) are not possible'. Coded as in earlier tranches for trials closed with a handful of patients (no / terminated_no_analysis); if the adjudicators prefer to count the registry posting as a disclosure, it is 2025-06-13, source type registry, result unclear, lag 53 days. Europe PMC by NCT: 37 records, all reviews or other trials citing it as ongoing; no abstract or paper of its own.

Shantou University Cancer Hospital (Chen Chuangzhen), neoadjuvant gemcitabine + cisplatin then radiotherapy vs concurrent chemoradiotherapy in bulky locally advanced cervical cancer, primary OS at 2 years. No result found. Registry: status unknown (last known recruiting, single centre, 290 planned), last updated Feb 2024, no results. Europe PMC by NCT: one 2022 review. PubMed (cervical + neoadjuvant + gemcitabine + chemoradiotherapy, 2022-2026; and by investigator + Shantou): nothing on this trial; a PLoS One paper of 2025-03-25 by the same group (PMID 40131890, abstract read) is a retrospective comparison of neoadjuvant chemotherapy plus surgery with chemoradiotherapy in stage IB3/IIA2, not this trial. Crossref title scans by design and by investigator: nothing. One Chinese-language web search: registry mirrors only. Medium because the estimated completion date (2025-06) is past, the record is stale and a single-centre trial of this size would most likely be reported in a Chinese journal or domestic meeting, which cannot be searched from here.

HELEN-008 (Henan Cancer Hospital, Liu Zhenzhen), adjuvant metronomic capecitabine vs placebo with endocrine therapy, primary iDFS. Not read out. Registry: still recruiting at the last update (Nov 2024), 1,979 planned, start Sep 2021, study completion 2028, no results; an event-driven iDFS analysis in a trial still enrolling in late 2024 is not plausible by now, whatever the registry's 2025-09 estimate. Europe PMC by NCT: 4 records, reviews listing it as an ongoing phase 3 (latest opened: Cancer Innov, 2025-11-10). PubMed (metronomic capecitabine + adjuvant + endocrine, 2022-2026): 0. Crossref title scans (metronomic + capecitabine + breast + endocrine; HELEN; by investigator), covering ASCO, ESMO and SABCS supplements: only other trials (MECCA, SYSUCC-001, metastatic phase 2 studies). No web search used.

EMT2 (University of Leeds, Hull; Yorkshire Cancer Research; Amarin), icosapent ethyl vs placebo after resection of colorectal liver metastases, primary PFS. No result found. Registry: active, not recruiting, 418 enrolled, estimated primary completion 2025-11-30, last updated Apr 2025, no results; EU register (2016-000628-24): no results. The protocol paper (BMJ Open, 2023-11-29, PMID 38030258, full text read) describes a 5.5-year recruitment period from March 2018 and at least 2 years of follow-up. Europe PMC by NCT (8 records) and by investigator since mid-2024, PubMed by acronym and by drug + liver metastases, Crossref title scans (eicosapentaenoic / icosapent / EMT2, 2021-2026; by investigator): no result abstract or paper. SEC full-text search for 'EMT2' since 2023: no Amarin filing. Two web searches: no results announcement; the search summaries say the Leeds trials unit page states results are due in 2026 and the Cancer Research UK page has no results yet, but the trial website itself returned 403 and was not opened. ESMO 2026 (late Oct 2026) abstracts are not yet public.

which_endpoint: OS (per research comparison; multi-arm multi-stage platform)
search_notes: STAMPEDE (MRC). TREAT WITH CARE, probably not scorable as one trial: a multi-arm multi-stage platform with about ten research comparisons read out separately between 2011 and 2026, so there is no single primary analysis and the registry date (2026-03, estimated; record not updated since Apr 2023) belongs to none of them in particular. Row dated to the earliest arm-level readout I could read: Lancet Oncol paper on the celecoxib arm (PMID 22452894, abstract read through Europe PMC, names NCT00268476; online 2012-03-26): at the second intermediate analysis there was no evidence of benefit on failure-free survival (HR 0.94, 0.74-1.20) and accrual to both celecoxib arms was stopped for lack of benefit. A congress abstract with the same title was deposited on 2011-09-23 (Eur J Cancer 47 suppl, DOI 10.1016/s0959-8049(11)70119-8; title seen, text could not be opened), so the true first disclosure is probably Sept 2011. Coded mixed across comparisons, each abstract read: docetaxel OS met and zoledronic acid not (ASCO 2015 abstract 5001, issue date 2015-05-20, read through OpenAlex: HR 0.76, 0.63-0.91 for docetaxel, 0.93 for zoledronic acid; Lancet 2015-12-21, PMID 26719232); metformin OS not met (ESMO 2024 LBA70, title seen; Lancet Oncol 2025-07-07, PMID 40639383: HR 0.91, 0.80-1.03, p=0.15); transdermal oestradiol non-inferior on 3-year metastasis-free survival (ESMO 2024 LBA69, title seen; NEJM 2026-03-25, PMID 41880608). The abiraterone, M1 radiotherapy and abiraterone + enzalutamide comparisons (2017-2021 papers, listed in the registry references) were not re-read. HR cells hold the first public OS hazard ratio (docetaxel comparison), not the 2012 failure-free survival figure. If scored on the comparisons open at the registry date, the first disclosures would be the ESMO 2024 late-breaking abstracts (deposited 2024-09-17, not opened). EU register (2004-000193-31) has results posted, not opened.

APEX (Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences; Hansoh, GeneCast), aumolertinib (almonertinib) with or without chemotherapy vs chemotherapy, adjuvant, stage II-IIIA EGFR-mutant NSCLC, primary DFS. No result found; estimated primary completion 2026-05. Only APEX abstract found is the trial-in-progress ASCO 2024 TPS8117 (read through Crossref, names NCT04762459: first patient Aug 2021, about 606 planned, no data). Registry: enrolling by invitation, not updated since Feb 2022, no results. Europe PMC by NCT: 16 records, reviews listing it as ongoing (latest read: Cancers, 2026-02-02). PubMed (aumolertinib/almonertinib + adjuvant + randomised/phase 3/APEX): only ARTS. Crossref title scan (aumolertinib/almonertinib + adjuvant/resected/APEX, 2021-2026, covering ASCO, ESMO, ELCC and WCLC supplements): nothing for APEX. One Chinese-language web search: nothing. Sibling to beware: ARTS / HS-10296-302 (NCT04687241, Hansoh-sponsored, placebo-controlled; AACR 2025 CT126, Lancet Oncol 2026-01-12) is positive and is not this trial; APPOINT, ADVANCE and several real-world series are also different studies. Hansoh exchange filings were not read. WCLC 2026 abstracts may not yet be indexed.

which_endpoint: Complete response rate after induction (first of two primary endpoints; PFS not yet reported)
search_notes: Sun Yat-sen University (Mai Hai-Qiang), tislelizumab vs placebo with induction GP, chemoradiotherapy and adjuvant therapy; called BEACON in a 2026 review, a name the registry does not carry. ASCO 2024 abstract 6001 (oral), 'Interim analysis of a multicenter, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind, phase 3 trial', names NCT05211232; read in full through the Crossref record because ascopubs.org refuses scripted fetches. Dual primary endpoints, complete response rate after induction and PFS; the planned interim analysis tested complete response at alpha 0.005: 30.5% vs 16.7%, p=0.0006, 450 randomised, 'the trial met its first primary endpoint'. Coded met on that endpoint. No hazard ratio applies to it and no PFS result is public: a review of 2026-08-17 (PMID 42605281, full text read) reports the same figures, gives PFS as not available and says follow-up continues; Crossref title scans (tislelizumab + nasopharyngeal, and by investigator, 2022 to Oct 2026, including ASCO 2025 and 2026) show no later report; registry active, not recruiting, updated 2026-05-29, primary completion 2026-06-02 (estimated), no results. DATE: 2024-06-01 is the supplement issue date in Crossref and OpenAlex; the Crossref DOI deposit is 2024-06-10, after the meeting, so it was not used. ASCO puts regular abstracts online about a week before the meeting, which would make the true date late May 2024; not confirmed (one web search did not find the abstract). Other tislelizumab nasopharyngeal abstracts are different studies (ASCO 2024 abstract 6045 retrospective; single-arm phase 2 trials; NCT05448885, a 50-patient phase 2 at another institute, has the same registry title).

CRYOMUNE (Institut Bergonie), cryoablation + pembrolizumab-pemetrexed-carboplatin vs the same without cryoablation, primary 1-year OS rate. Not read out. Registry: recruiting, 214 planned, updated 2026-01-30, estimated primary completion 2026-08-27, no results. A review of 2026-08-14 (PMID 42666925, full text read) lists CRYOMUNE as recruiting and says it 'will provide the first definitive test of the strategy'. Europe PMC by NCT: 15 records, reviews only. PubMed by acronym and by cryoablation + pembrolizumab + lung + randomised: 0. Crossref title scan (cryoablation + lung + pembrolizumab/immunotherapy/CRYOMUNE, 2020-2026): no trial report. No web search used.

BEAT-MS (NIAID / Immune Tolerance Network; BMT CTN 1905), autologous stem cell transplant vs best available therapy in relapsing multiple sclerosis. NOT A CANCER TRIAL: flag for the exclusion review. Not read out. Registry: recruiting, 156 planned, record updated 2026-09-16, estimated primary completion 2026-10, 36-month relapse-free survival endpoint, no results. Europe PMC by NCT: 35 records, reviews and unrelated comparative cohorts; none reports the trial. PubMed by acronym: one 2021 recommendations paper. Crossref title scan: the registry entry and a 2020 design abstract only. No web search used.
